data_fields.name: named service types in pool
data_fields.donor_constant: 15 types (Alchemist, Armorer, Bank, Bookseller, ClothingStore, FurnitureStore, GemStore, GeneralStore, Library, GuildHall, PawnShop, WeaponSmith, Temple, Tavern, Palace)

data_fields.name: replacement keeps pool entry free
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: replacement FactionId != 0 returns the pool entry to unused

data_fields.name: nav tile weight, ground (secondary)
data_fields.donor_constant: water 0, stone 4, dirt 6, grass 12, road and road corners 15, other 7 (weight on a 0-15 scale)

best_idea: Fill each hub's service slots one at a time, in a fixed order, from a typed pool where each pool entry can be spent once, and report a short pool instead of silently zeroing the slot.
decision_why: The typed one-use pool fits zones as data and the server ledger; the donor's first-come layout order clusters services, and its empty-pool path copies zeros, so both change.
acceptance: A player entering a zone finds one temple, one tavern and one bank, each drawn from that zone's pool and spread across the hub; a server test asserts no pool entry is spent twice and an empty pool gives a seeded slot plus one report line, never zero values.
